Appearance

Young knight in his late twenties, sun-browned skin, shoulder-length brown hair tied back. Weathered chainmail over a green tabard with an oak-leaf crest.

What We Know

A knight of the Order of the Green Mantle who patrols Highreach's outer wards and farming hamlets. Popular with the common folk for his approachability and willingness to help.

First Impressions

Earnest and open-faced — speaks to peasants and nobles with the same warmth.
